known_mismatch.reason: Accepted deviation D2 (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Lone CR bytes in the generated PHP"; plans/parity-fixes.md, accepted deviations: follow-ups): with debug=true the compiled main class embeds the source in getSourceContext(), Compiler::string() leaves its lone CR bytes raw and PHP counts them as line breaks while Compiler counts only LF, so the class of the embedded template that follows maps its PHP lines to later markers. The controls (LF instead of CR, debug=false) match. Same form as errors/known-mismatches.json `cr-debug-embed-line`.
